about.title: About Me
about.description: I'm a computer science student with a strong interest in cybersecurity. Through my studies in France and Canada, I’ve built solid foundations in programming and teamwork, especially through hands-on school projects. My student jobs have also helped me develop key soft skills like communication, adaptability, and leadership. I’m curious, motivated, and always looking to learn something new — both in tech and in life.

ulaval.title: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science – Université Laval, Canada
ulaval.description: Currently expanding my expertise in computer science, with a strong emphasis on cybersecurity. I'm also gaining deeper insights into AI and databases, while engaging in numerous collaborative projects.

cytech.title: Engineering School in Computer Science – CyTech, France
cytech.description: This course enabled me to consolidate my knowledge of algorithms, data structures, programming and mathematics. Several team projects helped me develop my problem-solving and collaboration skills.

louis-armand.title: Scientific Baccalaureate (engineering sciences concentration) – Lycée Louis Armand, France
louis-armand.description: This degree marked my first in-depth immersion in the engineering sciences. It gave me a solid foundation and enabled me to identify what really interested me: computer science.
